deviation: The 1x cap matches the standard. However, clause 11.2 leaves "wilful misconduct" uncapped, and the closing sentence takes the Customer's fee obligation outside the cap. The playbook allows uncapped liability only for fraud, IP infringement indemnity and breach of confidentiality. Death/personal injury and non-excludable liability can't be limited by law, so those are fine. The 12-month look-back before the claim can also give a lower cap than "annual fees paid or payable" early in the term.
suggested_text: 11.1 Subject to clauses 11.2 and 11.3, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or in connection with this Agreement, whether in contract, tort (including negligence) or otherwise, shall not exceed one (1) times the annual Fees paid or payable under this Agreement. 11.2 Nothing in this Agreement limits or excludes liability for (a) death or personal injury caused by negligence, (b) fraud or fraudulent misrepresentation, (c) liability under the IP infringement indemnity in clause 10, (d) breach of confidentiality, or (e) any liability that cannot be limited or excluded by law. 11.3 Neither Party is liable for indirect or consequential loss or loss of anticipated profit, except to the extent such loss is recoverable under an indemnity in clause 10. [Delete the final sentence, or limit it to "undisputed Fees properly due for Services delivered".]
